whole-sign-physical-occupation-v1.label: Whole Sign physical-occupation convention v1
whole-sign-physical-occupation-v1.formula: house = 1 + ((graha Rasi index - local Lagna Rasi index + 12) mod 12). “Occupies Lagna” means physical occupation of house 1; it does not mean aspect, lordship, Shadbala or Lagna strength.

annaprasana-natural-malefic-lagna-v1.label: Annaprasana natural-malefic Lagna convention v1
annaprasana-natural-malefic-lagna-v1.formula: Reject Surya, Kuja, Shani, mean Rahu or mean Ketu in Whole Sign house 1. When Chandra occupies house 1, let E = (Chandra longitude - Surya longitude) mod 360 degrees: 0 < E < 180 is waxing and does not fail; 180 < E < 360 is waning and fails. Return unknown within ±0.02 degrees of 0 or 180. Budha joined to a natural malefic is represented by same-sign occupation; the accompanying malefic already controls this prohibition.

phaladeepika-well-placed-v1.label: Phaladeepika well-placed convention v1
phaladeepika-well-placed-v1.formula: Outside houses 6, 8 and 12; outside an enemy Rasi; and outside debilitation Rasi or Navamsa. Chandra must also clear Surya by more than the disclosed 12-degree v1 solar-ray threshold.

phaladeepika-full-graha-drishti-v1.label: Phaladeepika full Graha Drishti convention v1
phaladeepika-full-graha-drishti-v1.formula: Every classical graha fully aspects the 7th; Kuja also the 4th and 8th, Guru the 5th and 9th, and Shani the 3rd and 10th. Rahu, Ketu and partial aspects are excluded.

wedding: Assess malefic occupancy or hemming around Lagna and any Chandra-Graha association.
Review the optional fortification combinations and both partners’ compatibility, Tarabala, Chandrabala and Panchaka.
seemantha: If relying on Pournami, assess the source’s qualitative Chandra-dignity condition.
gruhapravesha: Assess Guru, Shukra and Chandra strength, benefic/malefic placement, rising-Rasi ownership and the Navamsa exception.
property: Assess the weekday lord in Lagna, harmony between Lagna and 7th lords, and whether the 11th lord occupies the 12th.
house_purchase: Assess whether a malefic occupies the 7th house.
purchase: Keep malefics outside the 8th and 12th houses, and assess whether benefics occupy the 2nd, 10th or 11th.
job: Assess whether a benefic strengthens Lagna and complete the employer/employee compatibility checks.
ceremony: Assess combustion, exceptional omens and whether the remedial-urgency exception applies.
travel: Assess general Lagna fortification, whether Guru or Shukra is well placed in Lagna, waxing Chandra and malefic occupancy of the 7th house.
surgery: Assess the operated-body-part Rasi and house, malefic affliction, Mangala strength and Mangala-Shani aspects.
